text: Supported Projects Chörten sind buddhistische Kultbauten in der Himalaya-Region. Sie dienen als Behältnis für Opfergaben und Reliquien, die das Böse abwehren sollen. We support the historical humanities and other fields of research – from archaeology to contemporary history. Projects supported by the Foundation The first Gerda Henkel Foundation Annual Report for 1977 notes that the Board of Trustees and the Management approved funding of some 540,000 deutschmarks for 21 projects. Since then, the Foundation’s total assets and the number of projects supported have gratifyingly risen. Only ten years later almost 500 scientific undertakings had been supported, and a total of around 14.5 million deutschmarks had been allocated to them. At present, the head office is liaising with some 1,991 on-going projects that are receiving funding – and in the almost 50 years of the Foundation’s existence, around 9,000 research projects have been supported worldwide, with total funds committed of about EUR 310 million.
